docs.title: What is Textevo?
docs.text: Textevo is a text animation tool for After Effects. It breaks down a text animation letter by letter, word by word or line by line: animate once, and every letter, word or line follows with the delay you choose.

docs.title: How does it work?
docs.text:
When you click Add, Textevo puts two things on your text layer:

  • a Textevo effect, which gathers all the controls: strength, delay, direction, position, scale, rotation, opacity, blur...
  • a text animator, linked to the effect by expressions, which does the work on the text.

You animate the Strength of the effect: at 100 % the text is fully transformed (moved, scaled, transparent...), at 0 % it is back to normal. Each letter, word or line plays this animation with the delay you have set.

You can stack as many Textevo as you want on the same text layer: one for the arrival, one for the exit, one for an animation in between...

New to Textevo?

Watch the video tutorial and follow Getting started to make your first animation in a few minutes, then read the Quick tips to save a lot of clicks.

docs.title: What's new in Textevo 2026 (beta)
docs.text:
Motion: Elastic, Bounce and Oscillation The new Motion button adds an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation to the strength of a Textevo, with its own controls in the effect. Textevo can optimize your keyframes so the effect really shows. Presets that land where you expect Presets are applied from the start of the text layer (or at the current time with Alt + click), on all the selected text layers or on a new one. The presets window has a search field and a rename button. Your old presets are updated automatically. Presets that keep your whole look The selectors and properties you add to the Textevo text animator (wiggly selector, fill color...) are saved in the presets and kept when you copy, switch 2D / 3D or change the motion. Presets can also save the other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow...). And also Alt + click on Add for the reversed animation with mirrored easing, Alt + click on Paste to paste at the current time, a new settings window, dialogs in the After Effects colors and many fixes.

See the version history for all the changes.

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Textevo is made by Wlazinski Matthieu, with the help of the community of motion-cafe.com.

Textevo is available on aescripts + aeplugins. For help, bug reports or ideas, open a support ticket from the product page.

docs.title: Controls
docs.text: All the controls of a Textevo are in its effect:

docs.title: Strength
docs.text:
The intensity of the Textevo, the parameter you animate.

  • 100 %: the text gets all the Transform and Style values of the effect.
  • 0 %: the text is back to normal.

Each letter, word or line plays the Strength animation with its own delay.

You can add expressions on the Strength (wiggle, loopOut...) or use your favorite easing scripts. For an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation, use the Motion button: it follows the delay of each letter.

docs.title: Delay
docs.text:
The time between two letters, words or lines, in frames.

With a delay of 2, the second letter starts 2 frames after the first one, the third one 4 frames after... Negative values are possible.

docs.title: Direction
docs.text:
The order in which the letters, words or lines play the animation:

Direction Order Reading direction from the first to the last Reversed from the last to the first Outward from the center to the edges Inward from the edges to the center Random in a random order, changed with the Random Seed From index from the letter, word or line set with From index, towards both edges

docs.title: From index
docs.text: With the From index direction: the letter, word or line where the animation starts.

docs.title: Random Seed
docs.text: With the Random direction: change it to get another random order.

docs.title: Transform
docs.text:
What the text gets at 100 % of strength, relatively to its normal state:

  • Anchor Point, Position (X, Y, Z): offsets in pixels
  • Scale (or X, Y, Z with Separate XYZ)
  • Skew (angle and axis)
  • Rotation (and X, Y, Z rotations when the layer is in 3D per character)
  • Opacity

Example

With a Position Y of 100 and a strength of 50 %, the text is moved by 50 px on Y.

docs.title: Style
docs.text: Works like Transform, with: Stroke Width, Line Anchor, Tracking Amount, Line Spacing, Character Offset, Character Replace and Blur.

docs.title: Motion controls
docs.text: A Textevo with a Motion has an extra group at the end of its effect: Elastic, Bounce or Oscillation, with its own controls.

docs.title: My preset lands far after my text layer, sometimes out of the composition
docs.text: This was a bug of the presets saved before Textevo 2026: they stored their keyframes from the start of the composition they were saved in. Update Textevo, open the presets window and accept to update your old presets: see Presets saved with an older version.

docs.title: My elastic or bounce doesn't show
docs.text: The Elastic and the Bounce start from the speed of the Strength when it reaches a keyframe: a keyframe eased on arrival arrives with a speed of 0, and nothing happens after it. Let Textevo optimize the keyframes, or make them arrive linear: see Eased keyframes.

docs.title: Why use the Remove and Rename buttons?
docs.text:
A Textevo is made of an effect and a text animator linked by expressions. After Effects doesn't tell scripts when you delete or rename an effect by hand, so Textevo cannot fix things afterwards:

  • deleting the effect by hand leaves its text animator on the layer, with expression errors: delete it by hand too, or better, use the Remove button;
  • renaming the effect by hand updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator: use the Rename button to keep both names in sync.

docs.title: Why isn't "Based on" in the effect?
docs.text: This option can't be controlled by expressions, that's why it is a button of the panel.

docs.title: Why isn't there a fill color in the effect?
docs.text:
It would override the color of your text even at 0 % of strength. But you can add a Fill Color (or a stroke...) to the Textevo text animator yourself, with the Add menu of the animator: it follows the strength like the other properties.

What you add to the text animator is kept when you copy the Textevo, save it as a preset, switch 2D / 3D or change its motion.

docs.title: Can a preset save a drop shadow, a glow or my own selectors?
docs.text: Yes. What you add to the Textevo text animator (a wiggly selector, a fill color...) is always saved. The other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow, blur...) are saved when you save the whole layer and choose Save all: see Save a preset.

docs.title: Can I apply a preset on several layers?
docs.text: Yes: select all the text layers, then apply the preset. With no text layer selected, Textevo creates one.

docs.title: How do I share my presets?
docs.text: A preset is a .json file in the presets folder of Textevo (see Where are the presets?). Send the file: the other person copies it in their presets folder and clicks refresh in the presets window.

docs.title: After Effects asks to allow scripts to write files
docs.text: Textevo saves its settings and presets on your computer: check "Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network" in the preferences. See Installation.

docs.title: Video tutorial
docs.text: TextEvo Tutorial: The Basics shows the main steps. It was made with Textevo 2: the panel of Textevo 2026 has a few more buttons (like Motion), the basics are the same.

docs.title: Step by step
docs.text: Your first Textevo animation: letters that rise and fade in, one after the other.

docs.title: 1. Add a Textevo
docs.text:
Select a text layer (or nothing: Textevo creates a text layer for you) and click Add in the Textevo panel.

Textevo adds:

  • a TextEvo effect on the layer, with all the controls,
  • two keyframes on its Strength: 100 % at the current time, 0 % one second later.

Info

The duration, the influence of the keyframes, the delay and the direction of a new Textevo are set in the settings.

docs.title: 2. Choose what moves
docs.text:
Open the TextEvo effect in the Effect Controls. By default the Transform values change nothing: set what the letters do at 100 % of strength, for example:

  • Transform > Position > Y: 80 (the letters come from 80 px lower)
  • Transform > Opacity: 0 (the letters are transparent at the start)

Play the animation: at 100 % the letters are moved down and transparent, at 0 % they are at their normal place. Each letter plays it a little after the previous one.

docs.title: 3. Adjust the rhythm
docs.text:
• Delay: the number of frames between two letters. Increase it for a slower cascade.
  • Direction: reading direction, reversed, from the center (outward), towards the center (inward), random or from a given index.
  • Move the Strength keyframes and change their easing like any keyframes, in the timeline or the graph editor.

docs.title: 4. Letters, words or lines
docs.text:
Click Based on in the panel to animate the text letter by letter, letter by letter without the spaces, word by word or line by line.

With "Auto adapt the delay" checked, the delay is adjusted to keep about the same total duration.

docs.title: 5. Animate the exit
docs.text:
Hold Alt and click Add: this adds a second Textevo with reversed keyframes (0 % then 100 %), to make the text leave. Set its Transform values (for example Position Y -80 and Opacity 0) and move its keyframes to the end of the layer.

You can stack as many Textevo as you want on the same layer.

docs.title: 6. Go further
docs.text:
• Add an elastic, a bounce or an oscillation with the Motion button.
  • Save your animation as a preset to reuse it on any text in one click.
  • Read the Quick tips: the shortcuts and behaviors that save a lot of clicks.
  • Add your own selectors or properties to the Textevo text animator (a wiggly selector, a fill color...): they are kept in the copies and presets.

docs.title: 1. Allow scripts to write files
docs.text:
Textevo saves its settings and presets on your computer, After Effects has to allow it:

  • After Effects 2020 and later: Edit > Preferences > Scripting & Expressions
  • Older versions: Edit > Preferences > General

and check Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network.

On macOS, the Preferences are in the After Effects menu.

docs.title: 2. Install the panel
docs.text:
The easiest way is the aescripts + aeplugins manager: it installs Textevo for you.

To install by hand, in After Effects: File > Scripts > Install ScriptUI Panel... and select textevo.jsxbin. Do it again with textevo presets.jsxbin (a separate download) to get the presets manager as a dockable panel too (optional).

Or copy textevo.jsxbin and textevo presets.jsxbin directly into the ScriptUI Panels folder of After Effects, not in a subfolder:

WindowsmacOS 
C:\Program Files\Adobe\Adobe After Effects <version>\Support Files\Scripts\ScriptUI Panels\

/Applications/Adobe After Effects <version>/Scripts/ScriptUI Panels/

docs.title: 3. Restart After Effects
docs.text:
Open the panel from the Window menu > textevo.jsxbin, and dock it where you like: the panel adapts to a vertical or horizontal layout.

With textevo presets.jsxbin installed, Window > textevo presets.jsxbin opens the presets manager as a panel you can dock too.

docs.title: First launch
docs.text: Textevo asks for a folder where it saves its settings and presets. If you cancel, your Documents folder is used. You can change it later in the settings.

docs.title: Updating from an older version
docs.text:
• Install textevo.jsxbin as above, and remove the older Textevo files from the ScriptUI Panels folder (textevo2.jsx, Textevo.jsx, textEvo241118.jsx..., and on macOS a file named Textevo_2026.0.0\Textevo.jsx), or you will have two Textevo panels in the Window menu.
  • Your settings are kept.
  • Your presets are kept too. The first time you open the presets window, Textevo offers to update the presets saved with an older version: see Presets saved with an older version.
  • The Textevo already in your projects keep working.

docs.title: Interface
docs.text:
The Textevo panel adapts to its size: dock it vertically or horizontally.

From left to right (or from top to bottom): Add, Remove, Rename, Based on, 2D / 3D, Motion, Copy, Paste, Presets and Settings. Hover a button to see what it does.

The buttons try to do what you mean:

  • they work on the selected Textevo effects, or on all the Textevo of the selected text layers when no Textevo is selected,
  • they work on all the selected text layers at once,
  • when there is nothing to work on, Add, Motion, Paste and applying a preset create a text layer for you; the other buttons tell you what to select.

Always use the Remove and Rename buttons

A Textevo is made of two parts: the Textevo effect and a text animator on the text layer, linked by expressions. Removing or renaming the effect by hand only changes one of the two parts. Use the Remove and Rename buttons of the panel, which handle both.

docs.title: Add
docs.text:
Adds a Textevo to all the selected text layers. If no text layer is selected, Textevo creates one in the active composition.

  • Click: keyframes on the Strength from 100 % to 0 %, starting at the current time (an arrival).
  • Alt + click: the reversed animation, from 0 % to 100 %, with mirrored easing (an exit).

The keyframes, their easing, the delay and the direction of a new Textevo are set in the settings.

docs.title: Remove
docs.text:
Removes the selected Textevo, or all the Textevo of the selected layers: the effect and its text animator.

If you delete the effect by hand, its text animator stays on the layer with expression errors, and has to be deleted by hand too.

docs.title: Rename
docs.text:
Renames the selected Textevo effect and its text animator together. If you select the text layer and it has only one Textevo, that one is renamed.

If you rename the effect by hand, After Effects updates the expressions but not the name of the text animator: the effect and its animator no longer have the same name in the timeline.

docs.title: Based on
docs.text:
Chooses how the text is broken down: Letters, Letters spaceless, Words or Lines.

Auto adapt the delay: adjusts the delay to the new number of letters, words or lines, to keep about the same total duration. For example, switching from 12 letters to 3 words multiplies the delay by 4.

Match the anchor point grouping: also sets the Anchor Point Grouping of the layer (in the More Options of the text): Character for letters, Word for words, Line for lines. A scale or a rotation then turns each word or line around its own center. Uncheck it to keep your own grouping. Its default state is in the settings.

docs.title: 2D / 3D
docs.text: Switches the 3D per character of the selected text layers on or off. The Textevo animators are rebuilt with the 2D or 3D properties (3D rotations, Z position...), keeping your settings and what you added to them.

docs.title: Motion
docs.text: Adds an Elastic, a Bounce or an Oscillation to the strength of the Textevo. On a text layer without Textevo, or with no text layer selected, it creates a Textevo with this motion, ready to play. See Motion.

docs.title: Copy
docs.text: Copies the selected Textevo, or all the Textevo of the layer: the effects with their keyframes, their motion, their "Based on" mode and what you added to their text animators.

docs.title: Paste
docs.text:
Pastes the copied Textevo on all the selected text layers, or on a new text layer if none is selected.

  • Click: the keyframes keep their position from the start (in point) of the layer: a keyframe on the first frame of the copied layer lands on the first frame of the target layer.
  • Alt + click: the first keyframe lands at the current time.

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
• Click: opens the presets window.
  • Shift + click: saves the Textevo of the selected layer as a preset.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text: Opens the settings: the default values of a new Textevo, the presets folder...

docs.title: Motion
docs.text:
The Motion button adds an Elastic, a Bounce or an Oscillation to the strength of a Textevo.

Select one or more Textevo effects (or text layers, for all their Textevo), click Motion and choose:

  • a Textevo gets the chosen motion, keeping its keyframes,
  • a text layer without Textevo gets a new Textevo with this motion,
  • with no text layer selected, Textevo creates a text layer with a Textevo and this motion.

A Textevo created with an Elastic or a Bounce is ready to play: its two keyframes are 12 frames apart (see the settings), with a slow departure and a linear arrival, so the overshoot shows right away.

Motion What it does Controls None back to the standard Textevo Elastic overshoots and wobbles after each keyframe Amplitude, Frequency, Decay Bounce bounces back after each keyframe Elasticity, Gravity, Max bounces Oscillation a continuous sine wave on the strength Amplitude, Frequency, Phase per character

The motion controls are in a new group at the end of the effect: tweak and keyframe them like any other parameter.

The motion follows the delay of each letter, word or line, like the rest of the animation. The effect keeps its name, its position, its keyframes and its "Based on" mode, and the motion is saved in the copies and the presets.

docs.title: Elastic
docs.text:
After each keyframe of the Strength, the text goes past its value and wobbles back to it.

  • Amplitude: how far it goes past the value.
  • Frequency: the number of wobbles per second.
  • Decay: how fast the wobbles fade out.

docs.title: Bounce
docs.text:
After each keyframe of the Strength, the text bounces back, like a ball on the floor.

  • Elasticity: the height of each bounce compared to the previous one.
  • Gravity: higher values give faster, smaller bounces.
  • Max bounces: the number of bounces.

docs.title: Oscillation
docs.text:
A continuous sine wave added to the strength, even without keyframes: floating texts, pulses...

  • Amplitude: the size of the oscillation, in % of strength.
  • Frequency: the number of oscillations per second.
  • Phase per character: offsets each letter, word or line, for a wave through the text.

docs.title: Eased keyframes
docs.text:
The Elastic and the Bounce start from the speed of the Strength when it reaches a keyframe. A keyframe eased on arrival (Easy Ease, or the "Second key" influence of the settings) arrives with a speed of 0: nothing happens after it.

When you choose Elastic or Bounce, or paste or apply a preset using them, Textevo detects these keyframes and asks what to do:

  • Optimized keys: linear arrival, and a slow departure from the previous keyframe (at least 75 % of influence): the speed builds up and the keyframe is reached fast. The strongest effect.
  • Linear arrival: only removes the ease on arrival.
  • Keep the keys: changes nothing.

Check Don't ask again to always do the same thing. The choice can be changed in the settings: "Elastic / bounce on eased keys".

Tip

Keyframes closer to each other also give a stronger elastic or bounce: the arrival is faster.

docs.title: Delay from markers
docs.text:
The Delay panel of the Motion window chooses what starts each letter, word or line:

  • Frames: the usual delay, in frames between two letters, words or lines (the Delay of the effect).
  • Markers: each letter, word or line starts at a marker of the layer: the first one at the first marker, the second at the second marker... Move the markers to change the timing, for example to sync the words with a voice over. The name of the markers doesn't matter.

Add or update the markers adds one marker per letter, word or line (according to the Based on mode and the Direction), named after it, from the first keyframe of Strength. The markers already added by Textevo are replaced: after correcting the text, click Markers again to get the markers of the new text. The markers you added yourself stay. It is checked when a selected layer has no markers, or when its text no longer matches the markers of Textevo. The markers are added:

  • At a reading speed (by default, 180 words per minute): a long word stays longer than a short one, and the text pauses after a comma, longer after a period or at the end of a line. The rhythm of someone reading the text, a good start for kinetic typography; move a few markers to fine-tune it. When the text needs more time than the layer, the layer is lengthened.
  • Spread over the layer: the same time between the markers, the last one so that its animation ends at the end of the layer.

The choice and the speed are remembered, and used by the presets too (see the settings). With the Random direction, the markers are always spread over the layer: the order of the letters is only known by the expression.

  • The animation of each letter, word or line is the one of the keyframes of Strength, moved to start at its marker.
  • With the Outward or Inward direction, the letters that start together share a marker.
  • The letters, words or lines after the last marker keep the delay in frames after it.
  • The markers mode is kept by the copies, the presets, 2D / 3D and the motions. The markers themselves are not copied: pasted or applied as a preset on a layer without markers, the Textevo adds its markers, one per letter, word or line of the new text. A layer that already has markers keeps them.
  • With nothing selected, Markers creates a text layer with a Textevo in markers mode.

Note

The markers are shared by all the Textevo of the layer: use the markers mode on one Textevo (the entrance for example) and the delay in frames on the others.

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
Save your Textevo animations and apply them on any text in one click.

Open the presets window with the Presets button of the panel.

docs.title: Dockable presets panel
docs.text:
Install textevo presets.jsxbin next to textevo.jsxbin (see Installation): the presets manager becomes a panel of After Effects, that you can dock next to your timeline or your Effect Controls, like any panel. Open it from Window > textevo presets.jsxbin.

  • The Presets button of the Textevo panel opens it, instead of the floating window.
  • Its list updates by itself when you save, rename or remove a preset from the Textevo panel or from another presets window.
  • It works exactly like the presets window described below.

docs.title: Save a preset
docs.text:
Select a text layer with Textevo, then click add in the presets window, or Shift + click the Presets button of the panel. Give your preset a name.

  • If you selected some Textevo effects, only those are saved.
  • If you selected the whole layer and it has other effects (drop shadow, glow, blur...), Textevo lists them and asks what to save, in the same window as the name:
    • Save all: the Textevo and the other effects of the layer.
    • Textevo only: only the Textevo.
    • Cancel: nothing is saved.

docs.title: What a preset contains
docs.text:
• The Textevo effects, with their values, keyframes and expressions, and their Motion.
  • Their "Based on" mode, their delay from markers and the 3D per character of the layer.
  • What you added to the Textevo text animators: other selectors (wiggly, range, expression...) and properties (fill color, stroke...), with their values, keyframes and expressions.
  • With Save all: the other effects of the layer, in their order, enabled or not.

The keyframes are saved from the start (in point) of the layer.

docs.title: Apply a preset
docs.text:
Select one or more presets and click apply, or double click a preset.

  • The presets are applied on all the selected text layers.
  • If no text layer is selected, Textevo creates one in the active composition, like the Add button. Its text shows the preset: a sentence for a preset based on words, a few lines for a preset based on lines.
  • The keyframes start from the start (in point) of each layer.
  • Alt + click on apply (or Alt + double click): the first keyframe lands at the current time.
  • A preset with the delay from markers, applied on a layer without markers, adds the markers: one per letter, word or line of the text of the layer.

Effects that are not installed

If a preset contains effects that are not installed on your computer (third party effects), they are skipped and Textevo lists them.

Effects that point to other layers

Effect parameters that point to another layer (a displacement map, a source layer...) are not saved: they have no meaning in another composition.

docs.title: Find a preset
docs.text:
The list shows, for each preset, what its Textevo are based on (letters, words, lines...) and their motion (elastic, bounce, oscillation, and Markers for the delay from markers). The presets are sorted by name.

  • Search: type a part of a name to filter the list (not case sensitive).
  • Based on and Motion: show only the presets based on words, or with an elastic... The filters work together with the search.

docs.title: Rename, remove
docs.text:
• rename: renames the selected preset (one at a time).
  • remove: deletes the selected presets, after a confirmation.
  • refresh: reloads the list, for example after copying preset files in the folder.

docs.title: Where are the presets?
docs.text: In the presets folder of the Textevo folder chosen at the first launch (see the settings). A preset is a .json file: copy it to share it, or to use it on another computer.

docs.title: Presets saved with an older version
docs.text:
The presets saved before Textevo 2026 stored their keyframes from the start of the composition they were saved in: once applied, they could land far after the text layer, sometimes outside of the composition.

When the presets window opens, Textevo detects them and offers to update them, so that they start at the start of the layer. A copy of the original files is kept in the backup_before_2026 folder of your presets.

If you don't update them, you can still apply them with Alt + click: the first keyframe lands at the current time.

docs.title: Quick tips
docs.text: Textevo tries to guess what you want from what you select. These tips save a lot of clicks.

docs.title: Modifier keys
docs.text: Shortcut What it does Alt + click Add An exit: the keyframes go from 0 % to 100 %, with the easing mirrored. Alt + click Paste The first keyframe lands at the current time instead of the start of the layer. Alt + click apply (or Alt + double click a preset) Same for a preset: the first keyframe at the current time. Shift + click Presets Saves the Textevo of the selected layer as a preset, without opening the window.

docs.title: Let the selection do the work
docs.text:
• Select a Textevo effect to work on it only, select the text layer to work on all its Textevo: Remove, Copy, Motion and Based on follow this rule.
  • Select several text layers to Add, Paste, apply a preset, switch 2D / 3D or change the Based on mode on all of them at once.
  • Select nothing and click Add, Motion or Paste, or apply a preset: Textevo creates a text layer for you.
  • Rename a Textevo without looking for its effect: select the text layer, it works if the layer has only one Textevo.

docs.title: Animate faster
docs.text:
• An arrival and an exit on the same text: click Add at the start, then Alt + click Add at the end. Set the Transform values of each one, done.
  • An elastic title in one click: select nothing, click Motion > Elastic. You get a text layer with a Textevo whose keyframes are already set for the elastic (12 frames apart, see the settings).
  • Add an elastic to a plain text layer: select it and choose Motion > Elastic: it gets a Textevo ready to play.
  • Your favorite defaults: set the duration, the easing, the delay and the direction of a new Textevo in the settings, once and for all.
  • A wave through the text: Motion > Oscillation, then increase Phase per character.
  • Sync the words with a voice over: Based on > Words, then Motion > Markers: one marker per word is added, move each marker under its word in the audio.
  • Another random order: with the Random direction, change the Random Seed.

docs.title: Timing
docs.text:
• The Delay is in frames between two letters, words or lines. Changing the Based on mode with "Auto adapt the delay" keeps about the same total duration.
  • Closer keyframes give a stronger elastic or bounce.
  • If an elastic or a bounce doesn't show, the keyframes are eased on arrival: let Textevo optimize them (see Eased keyframes). Check "Don't ask again" if you always want the same answer.

docs.title: Presets
docs.text:
• Presets keep your whole look: add a wiggly selector, a fill color or a stroke to the Textevo text animator, they are saved with the preset. Select the whole layer and choose Save all to also save its drop shadow, glow...
  • Apply a preset on many texts at once: select all the text layers, then double click the preset.
  • Dock your presets: install textevo presets.jsxbin and dock the presets manager next to your timeline, your presets are always one double click away (see Dockable presets panel).
  • Find a preset fast: type a part of its name in the search field, or filter the list by Based on (letters, words, lines) and Motion (elastic, bounce...).
  • Share a preset: it is a .json file in your presets folder (Settings > Open). Send it, the other person copies it in their presets folder and clicks refresh.
  • Old presets landing far after the text? Accept the update when the presets window opens, or apply them with Alt + click.

docs.title: Keep things clean
docs.text:
• Always Remove and Rename a Textevo with the panel buttons: they handle the effect and its text animator together.
  • Switching 2D / 3D, renaming or changing the motion of a Textevo keeps everything you added to its text animator.

docs.title: Settings
docs.text:
Click the Settings button of the panel.

Change the values, then click Save. Cancel closes the window without saving, Reset puts back the default values (saved when you click Save).

docs.title: Add button
docs.text:
The values used when you click Add.

Add keyframes on Strength Adds two keyframes on the strength of the new Textevo: from 100 % to 0 %, or from 0 % to 100 % with Alt + click on Add. Unchecked, the Textevo is added without keyframes. Duration (seconds) The time between the two keyframes. Keyframe influence (%) The easing of the two keyframes: the In and Out influence of the First key and of the Second key, from 0 (linear) to 100. With Alt + click on Add, the easing is mirrored. Delay (frames between characters) The delay of the new Textevo. Direction The direction of the new Textevo. Based on : auto adapt the delay When you change the "Based on" mode, adjusts the delay to the new number of letters, words or lines. Based on : match the anchor point grouping When you change the "Based on" mode, also sets the anchor point grouping of the layer: character, word or line. This is the default state of the checkbox of the Based on window.

docs.title: Motion
docs.text: New elastic / bounce : frames between keys A Textevo created with the Motion button (on a text layer without Textevo, or with no text layer selected): the number of frames between its two keyframes. 12 by default: closer keyframes give a stronger elastic or bounce. Delay from markers : added markers How the markers are added for the delay from markers, by the Motion window and the presets: At a reading speed (long words and punctuation take longer) or Spread over the layer. Reading speed (words per minute) The speed of At a reading speed: 180 by default, about the speed of a text read on screen; 250 for a fast reader. Elastic / bounce on eased keys What to do with the keyframes eased on arrival when an Elastic or a Bounce is set: Ask, Keep the keys, Linear arrival or Optimized keys. See Eased keyframes.

docs.title: Presets folder
docs.text:
Where Textevo saves its settings and presets. Open shows the folder, Change... chooses another one.

Note

Changing the folder doesn't move your presets: copy the presets folder to the new place if you want to keep them.

docs.title: About
docs.text: The version of Textevo, and a link to this documentation.

docs.title: 2026.1.0 (beta)
docs.text:
The Fx button is renamed Motion: in After Effects, "fx" already means the effects.

Textevo tries to do what you mean:

  • Motion on a text layer without Textevo, or with no text layer selected: creates a Textevo with this motion, with keyframes ready for the elastic or the bounce (12 frames apart by default, see the settings).
  • Add and 2D / 3D work on all the selected text layers.
  • Paste creates a text layer when none is selected, like the presets.
  • Rename works when the text layer is selected, if it has only one Textevo.
  • Copy keeps the previous copy when the selected layer has no Textevo.
  • The buttons tell you what to select instead of doing nothing.
  • Presets list: columns showing what each preset is based on and its motion, and filters by Based on and Motion. The buttons keep their size when the window grows.
  • Changing the motion (or 2D / 3D, copying, applying a preset...) keeps all the settings of the selectors added to the text animator: Shape, Units, Based On of a range selector...
  • Delay from markers (Motion window): each letter, word or line starts at a marker of the layer, to sync a text with a voice over. Textevo can add the markers for you, at a reading speed (long words and punctuation take longer) or spread over the layer, and update them after you change the text. The presets add them to the layers without markers. The presets list shows them in the Motion column and filter.
  • Package: the script is now textevo.jsxbin. Remove the older Textevo files from the ScriptUI Panels folder (see Installation).
  • Fixed: the blank panel on macOS, caused by the package of 2026.0.0: the script was installed as a file named Textevo_2026.0.0\Textevo.jsx.
  • Based on can also set the anchor point grouping of the layer (character, word, line), checked by default (see the settings).
  • Dockable presets panel: install textevo presets.jsxbin (a separate download) to dock the presets manager like any After Effects panel. The Presets button opens it, and its list stays up to date.

docs.title: 2026.0.0 (beta) - September 2026
docs.text:
New

  • Motion button (named Fx in this version): Elastic, Bounce or Oscillation on the strength, with their own controls. Textevo can optimize the keyframes eased on arrival.
  • Presets applied from the start of the text layer, or at the current time with Alt + click.
  • Presets applied on all the selected text layers, or on a new text layer when none is selected.
  • Presets window: search field and rename button, presets sorted by name.
  • Presets keep what you add to the text animator (wiggly selector, fill color...) and can save the other effects of the layer (drop shadow, glow...).
  • The presets saved with an older version are updated (a copy of the originals is kept).
  • Alt + click on Paste: at the current time.
  • Alt + click on Add: reversed keyframes with mirrored easing.
  • New settings window.
  • Dialogs in the After Effects colors.

Fixes

  • Presets landing far after the text layer, or outside of the composition.
  • Paste: the keyframes now follow the start of the target layer.
  • Copy, Based on, 2D / 3D and Remove on layers with the same name, or on a Textevo renamed by hand.
  • 2D / 3D keeps the "Based on" mode.
  • The default direction of the settings is applied by Add.
  • The first launch works when the folder choice is cancelled.
  • No more changes left out of the undo history.
  • Many smaller fixes.

docs.title: 2.0.0 - January 2020
docs.text:
Major new version:

  • A light and flexible interface.
  • An effect grouping the main parameters.
  • Stack as many Textevo as you want on a layer.
  • More animation directions (random, outward, inward...).
  • A preset system.
